title: Merchandise Purchases — Capture-Size Goodwill Bands for Double-Charged Units
content:
On a refund of a second capture of a Merchandise Purchases unit's payment, goodwill is banded by the unit's largest payment capture:

| Largest payment capture recorded for the unit | Capture-size goodwill |
|---|---|
| $500.00 or more (the large capture size) | large capture-size goodwill, $10.00 |
| $100.00 or more but below $500.00 (the middle capture size) | middle capture-size goodwill, $5.00 |

A unit whose largest capture is below $100.00 is outside these bands.

## Both sides of each band (hypothetical captures)

| Largest capture | Goodwill |
|---|---|
| $500.00 | $10.00 |
| $499.99 | $5.00 |
| $100.00 | $5.00 |
| $99.99 | outside these bands |
